raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c."Continent" = 'Asia' THEN h.population END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  CAST(SUM(h.population) AS DOUBLE) AS population_share
FROM main."country_history" h
JOIN main."country" c ON h.code = c."Code"
WHERE h.effective_month = '2026-03'
```
